Borowy Family Children’s Critical Care Tower
The Borowy Tower serves as the entryway to the grounds
of Baptist Medical Center Jacksonville and Wolfson
Children’s Hospital. The tower also houses the neonatal
and pediatric intensive care services and programs
The main check-in area for imaging registration patients

Complimentary parking is provided in P2 and P3

for the complimentary shuttle service is in the P2
garage in front of the first floor elevators.
For direct access to the facility from the P2
garage without having to cross the street, use the
Skybridge (select Level B in the elevators).
